_why: Headline quotes that tools/check_evidence.py cannot find in their own paper. Recorded with a reason rather than tolerated silently, so the gate still fails the moment a NEW one appears. estimates.csv says source_quote is the sentence the headline figure came from; for these it is not, and each entry says what it is instead. None of them is a transcription error: the papers' own text is intact.
